verdict.rationale: AMD's spec page documents NVMe boot and RAID 0/1/5/10 support for the 9950X3D. The general Ryzen page cites PCIe 5.0 storage support and Wi-Fi 6E, but as family-level marketing rather than a per-SKU I/O spec. That gives some storage and connectivity basis for planning a build, but not the detailed I/O headroom the story asks for. Missing for 10: PCIe lane counts and allocation, CPU-level PCIe generation specs for GPU and slots, USB/USB4/Thunderbolt or dock connectivity specs, and independent corroboration of I/O capabilities.
